rows.grounds: attribute of the deity as guardian of the mind
the deity personally chosen for worship
extends worship to include ordinary people

items.question: What universal appeal leads even an ordinary person to worship the chosen deity?
premises: The deity is addressed as mind-protecting.
The deity is addressed as the universe of universes.
Even an ordinary person performs worship.
items.inference: The deity's protective and all-encompassing nature makes worship accessible and compelling even to ordinary people.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of viśva+viśvam as a compound is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Even an ordinary person worships you, the chosen deity who protects the mind and encompasses all universes.
